## Team News

### Yarmoliuk returns for Brighton trip

Yehor Yarmoliuk

Yehor Yarmoliuk is available for Sunday’s game at Brighton after completing his three-match suspension.

Head coach Keith Andrews reported no fresh injury concerns following the win over Nottingham Forest. [...] Nine games into the 2026/27 Premier League season, Fabian Hürzeler's side are third in the table. They are two points behind Man City and five behind Arsenal – having already beaten both.

They have scored 24 goals, which is the most in the division, and conceded seven, which is the second fewest in the division. And they are averaging 2.11 points per game. Based on that average, they would pick up another 61 points this season, which would take them to 80. [...] Josh Dasilva is edging closer to a first-team return after featuring alongside Yarmoliuk for Brentford B on Monday.

Antoni Milambo has trained consistently but is not yet ready for selection.

Fábio Carvalho (knock) and Rico Henry (hip and quad) remain sidelined.
